name: Ligent Technologies, Inc.
summary: Ligent Technologies, Inc. manufactures optical-communication and optical-interconnect products. The company develops, manufactures, and sells optical transceivers, optical chips, and optical network terminals. The company's optical chip products include distributed feedback (DFB) laser chips and electro-absorption modulated laser (EML) chips, including high-power continuous-wave DFB lasers. It manufactures optical transceivers for AI and cloud applications. The company also offers data center interconnect solutions, including pluggable coherent transceivers, and storage and high-performance computing transceivers.
